why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose 0.81% while CTR (-0.02%) and Long Click Rate (-0.23%) stayed flat, so the gain is not coming from more clicks.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate - Head Queries fell 0.95% and Successful Search Rate - Mobile rose 0.74%; neither survived correction, so the mechanism is unknown.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The new ranker may resolve searches that used to end without a successful click, without changing click volume.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would make the test unreadable.
A daily effect series by days since first exposure that fades toward zero would mean the test needs more time.
A Head Queries drop that holds up in a follow-up cut would make this a trade-off for triage.
